summary: Remote WebSocket peer drives a local shell/PTY on the installer's host
details: @yeaft/webchat-agent connects outbound to a configured WebSocket server and dispatches server-sent messages into a local shell. The message router forwards `terminal_input` frames to a handler that writes the received bytes directly into a PTY spawned via node-pty (`process.env.SHELL || 'bash'` on Unix, PowerShell or `cmd` on Windows). Any peer that presents `AGENT_SECRET` to the configured server obtains full interactive command execution on the host running the agent. In addition, at agent startup the code runs `git clone https://github.com/yeaft/yeaft-skills.git` (or `git pull --ff-only`) into `~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/yeaft-skills-dev` against a mutable branch with no commit pinning or hash verification, copies the checkout into the Claude CLI plugin cache, and enables it in `~/.claude/settings.json`, so whatever the upstream repo currently holds becomes an enabled Claude plugin on the host on each start.
